messages:
Maria Gonzales: quick standup 1 needed: finalize long-term routing governance + isolation roadmap for product. goal = clear launch gates, prioritization for enterprise pilots, and minimal infra deps. thoughts?
Alex Choi: propose 3 lanes: latency-critical, cost-optimized, geo-restricted. each lane gets explicit SLOs, cache isolation knobs, and billing tags. mapping customers to lanes reduces scope.
Samir Kaur: agree. add a soft-fallback lane: 'resilient' that keeps legal posture but falls back to lower-capacity variants when overloaded. reduces incidents.
Jen Li: PM ask: we need concrete launch gates to communicate to sales. suggested gates: A) feature flag + enforcement hook present, B) telemetry emits per-tenant p50/p95/cost, C) canary with 5-15 tenants and rollback validated, D) support runbook + SLA language published.
Maria Gonzales: good. i'll draft that as: Gate 1 = policy primitives + flags, Gate 2 = telemetry + alerting + canary (<15 tenants, <10% traffic shift), Gate 3 = SLO validation + runbook + customer comms.
Alex Choi: add numeric SLOs by lane: latency-critical p95 < 120ms (short prompts), resilient p95 < 250ms, cost-optimized p95 < 350ms with target -40% token cost. also require KMS + audit logs for geo-restricted.
Samir Kaur: infra mechanics: we should implement routing-policy-weight + model-variant fallback. sample snippet: 
```
route_policy: geo-restricted
weight: 0.1  # 10% traffic to new lane
fallback_variant: v2-quantized
```
We can wire this into console rollouts.
Jen Li: migration policy for customers: propose a two-phase path: 6-week opt-in pilot, 4-week migration window, followed by a 2-week monitored ramp. opt-out and rollback must be automated. sales wants an SLA credit clause if migration causes regressions.
Maria Gonzales: can legal ops sign-off on that? Also need a clear acceptance test: per-tenant prompt suite (50-200 prompts based on workload), regression threshold <2% on quality metrics, cost impact <10% vs committed baseline.
Alex Choi: for Dedicated customers: require capacity reservation mapping to isolation lanes; otherwise we will enforce throttles. ops: ensure blackout windows for capacity shifts.
Samir Kaur: telemetry events minimal set: routing.decision.{tenant, lane, trace_id}, perf.metrics.{p50,p95,p99, cpu, gpu_util}, billing.delta.{tenant,lane}. plus KV-cache.isolation.marker.
ops-bot: ops-bot: canary-run started: routing-service v4.2 -> infra/canary (12 tenants). CI: passed, smoke: warning in eu-west-3 tail lat.
Alex Choi: smoke warning noted. EU-west-3 shows elevated IO latency; hold canary in that region until infra patch. update rollback playbook to include region-specific quick-stop.
Jen Li: i'll prepare customer comms templates: pilot invite, migration schedule, rollback expectations. tagging two enterprise pilots who need geo isolation.
Maria Gonzales: priorities for pilot: pick 8 tenants (mix of Dedicated + Hosted) and include both latency-critical and geo-restricted needs. ask infra for a list of eligible tenants.
Samir Kaur: action items for infra: 1) list infra deps (policy hooks, per-tenant SLOs, KV isolation), 2) define telemetry schema and retention, 3) create rollback script for routing weight back to 0.
Alex Choi: i'll own the perf budgets doc and acceptance checks. will add automated checks to CI: fail canary if p95 increases >10% or cost delta >15% for pilot tenants.
ops-bot: ops-bot: ack. scheduled blackout windows must be coordinated with sales before migration.
Maria Gonzales: final check: any objections to publishing a README + launch checklist before starting any canary? please react.
Alex Choi: :thumbsup:
Samir Kaur: :thumbsup:
Jen Li: :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzales: thanks everyone 1 i'll circulate the draft timeline and gate checklist by EOD.
